purpose: Pre-registered computational diagnosis of unchanged Static strengthened conditional MILP and default Master-Oracle on frozen synthetic PESS instances.

in_scope: read-only import of ess-advisor solver APIs
independent Fraction verification of tiny references and every claimed feasible incumbent
matched end-to-end endpoint-at-budget measurements and structural paired perturbations
out_of_scope: new PESS algorithms or separation theorems
paper, STATUS, or prior experiment edits

model.objective: original task-wise PESS sum of worst-case losses over labeled maximal matchings
model.maintenance: additive synthetic proxy supplied by the pinned instance; not a generic maintenance law
model.loss: nonnegative absolute signed pre-clamp affine log loss; Fraction arithmetic for independent verification

solver_variants.static: unchanged solve_static API with strengthened conditional MILP
solver_variants.master_oracle: unchanged solve_master_oracle API with default MasterOracleOptions; no cache/precompute switches in the primary comparison

corpus_plan.paired_design: The four medium-tier pairs differ in one declared graph feature while candidate count, task count, budget mode, zero-cost mode, and seed are held fixed; pair identity and changed feature are frozen in the manifest.
corpus_plan.generator_rng: Python random.Random with the explicit per-instance seed; no ambient randomness

budgets_and_limits.external_memory_cap: NOT ENFORCED unless the execution report records a separately configured cgroup/ulimit; peak RSS is measured when psutil is available
budgets_and_limits.thread_policy: one process per run; BLAS/HiGHS thread environment is recorded and simultaneous final solver runs are forbidden
budgets_and_limits.execution_order: deterministic randomized blocks from repetition seed; each block includes both methods and all endpoint budgets for one instance, with no simultaneous solver processes

primary: full invocation wall time including setup, solver call, and independent original-objective re-evaluation
time to independently checked feasible incumbent
solver-reported primal, dual, and MIP gap separately labeled
variables, rows, cuts/scenarios, oracle calls, cache hits, ordinary matching extrema calls
task-local graph signatures and tractable maximal-matching counts
metrics.interpretation: Separate endpoint runs are endpoint-at-budget observations, not continuous same-run incumbent traces. No solver-reported dual is treated as an independently justified global mathematical bound.

hypothesis.statement: Static time/model size is disproportionately driven by the number of task-local maximal-matching scenarios, whereas Master-Oracle time is disproportionately driven by task-sharing-induced repeated oracle evaluations and cuts.
hypothesis.falsification: Predeclared paired graph perturbations that change one feature must fail to show the predicted counter pattern after accounting for repetitions and endpoint censoring; retain the negative result if so.

evidence_labels.baseline: experimentally observed only for executed frozen inputs, environment, seeds, commands, and raw JSONL
evidence_labels.global_gap: NO CERTIFIED GLOBAL GAP unless an independent global lower-bound argument is recorded

freeze_rule: The manifest, generator code hash, input bytes, and SHA256SUMS are committed before any new solver comparison. Final measurement cannot remove, replace, or post-hoc filter frozen instances or timeout rows.
